evidence: (1) Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile (sha256 0a75419e...67d1) is byte-identical to the frozen template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/environment/Dockerfile (diff empty). It COPYs only instructions/ (line 14) and assets/ (line 15); /app is created, git-initialised and holds only .gitkeep committed as 'Initialize task workspace' (lines 17-23). No COPY of solution/ or tests/. The build context task/environment contains only Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json, instructions/{hireops_rules.md,integration.md}; no hidden/dot files (find -name '.*' empty). task.toml [environment] has no docker_image (lines 20-22), so no prebuilt image can smuggle content. (2) Assets are inputs only: seed_data.json (sha256 a1c65c80...3740) keys = generated_note, stages, candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, users(10), jobs(3), applications(16), messages(127), notes(3), reads(6). Starting records plus vocabulary; no precomputed answers (no expected unread counts, seen states, activity lines, undo results, routes, SQL schema, or UI). read_count values are input read markers defined in hireops_rules.md:206-208. It is byte-identical to solution/app/src/seed_data.json, which is expected (the golden copies the input), not a leak of the solution. (3) /instructions content is a spec, not a deliverable: hireops_rules.md:3-5 says 'Routes, field names, element ids, button labels and the shape of the pages are yours'; integration.md:14 'How routes and files are laid out under /app is up to you.' No route list, schema, skeleton or partial UI. Grep of environment/ and instruction.md for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|probe: zero hits. (4) Criterion-text leakage: token n-gram scan of both /instructions files against all 12 tests/**/*.toml|*.md files found no 10-gram overlap and only one 8-gram: 'place, the reason is shown, and keyboard focus' (hireops_rules.md:84-85 vs tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:137). That is the criterion restating the public requirement it grades, not rubric text appearing in the agent world; no criterion ids, pass/fail wording, weights or probe literals are present. Adversarial probes: a broken app cannot gain from the environment because no implementation is available to copy; a conforming alternative is not pushed toward a hidden design because the notes explicitly leave routes/ids/layout open. Limit: no agent image build or container listing of /app was run in this review (Docker not started per assignment); the conclusion rests on the template-identical Dockerfile and build-context contents, which deterministically yield /app = {.git, .gitkeep}.
